key_highlights: ASX under pressure following a US$1.4T Wall Street sell-off, though major banks provide support.
Westpac (WBC.AX) reports $6.8B profit but warns of an 11% property price decline as rate hikes bite.
Coles (COL.AX) suffers heavy market cap loss after ceding supermarket market share to Woolworths (WOW.AX).
Australian housing market experiences worst auction clearance since 2020 with values dropping for a seventh month.
Gold sector faces capitulation while energy transition costs threaten commercial and household utility bills.

sectors.trend: Bank earnings remain robust with WBC posting $6.8B profit, lifting major bank shares despite housing headwinds.
sectors.implications: Strong bank margins offset broader index drag, but rising credit risks and mortgage book pressure warrant caution.

sectors.trend: Market share divergence between Coles and Woolworths driving sharp valuation re-ratings.
sectors.implications: Institutional capital is rotating toward WOW.AX as COL.AX faces competitive and operational execution challenges.

sectors.trend: Gold equities see capitulation sell-offs alongside volatility across junior explorers.
sectors.implications: Margin compression for gold producers; selective opportunities emerging in battery and base metal explorers.

sectors.trend: Residential property prices slide for the seventh month with auction clearance at multi-year lows.
sectors.implications: Residential developers and REITs face NAV write-downs and muted buyer demand under elevated RBA rates.

sectors.trend: Accelerating grid transition and coal retirements driving structural upward pressure on electricity prices.
sectors.implications: Increased cash flow visibility for integrated generators (AGL.AX, ORG.AX), balanced against regulatory intervention risks.

key_themes: Divergence between resilient banking earnings and decelerating domestic property fundamentals.
Elevated public debt and persistent inflation complicating the RBA monetary easing timeline.
Global risk contagion spilling from Wall Street technology and equity volatility into ASX cyclical sectors.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential property developers and consumer discretionary; favour prime mortgage lenders.
Increase allocations to defensive yield, cash equivalents, and index hedging via put options.
Target low-geared balance sheets and avoid highly leveraged corporate issuers.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Woolworths relative to Coles on grocery market share gains
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is capturing competitive advantage and consumer traffic amid industry margin pressures.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate major bank dividend yields on earnings resilience
opportunities.rationale: WBC earnings resilience demonstrates strong net interest margins cushioning credit degradation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad market exposure against Wall Street spillover
defensive_moves.rationale: Global risk-off positioning and a $1.4T US wipeout leave the ASX 200 vulnerable to near-term multiple compression.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail REITs and homebuilding suppliers
defensive_moves.rationale: Seven consecutive months of dwelling value contractions and auction slumps signal further construction headwinds.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and range-bound as the ASX 200 digests global equity sell-offs and weakening domestic housing data.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive on quality defensive blue-chips once RBA terminal rates peak and inflationary pressures subside.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and updated domestic inflation forecasts.
US midterm election outcomes and subsequent trade/macro policy directions.
Australian housing market clearance rates and household consumption data.
Full-year Australian bank reporting and forward loan impairment provisioning.
watch_list: National housing price index and auction clearance rates
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR and global gold spot prices
